name: SGLang-TorchTPU official repository
description: Official SGLang PyTorch-native TPU backend, complementary to vLLM-TorchTPU and distinct from SGLang-JAX.

assertions.assertion: SGLang-TorchTPU official repository provides official guidance on Official SGLang PyTorch-native TPU backend, complementary to vLLM-TorchTPU and distinct from SGLang-JAX.
TorchTPU is the native PyTorch runtime replacing the deprecated PyTorch/XLA backend for TPU workloads.
vLLM-TorchTPU is the out-of-tree PyTorch-native serving backend for vLLM on TPUs, distinct from the JAX-native vllm-tpu backend.

qaPairs.answer: Official SGLang PyTorch-native TPU backend, complementary to vLLM-TorchTPU and distinct from SGLang-JAX.
